openings.claim: A removable carrier could restrain translation through clearance-limited edge contact while straps independently retain separation.
openings.delta: Merge prior carriers; specify non-preloading stops clear of the seal. Four bolts join two strip-clamp pairs; two serve withdrawable lateral stops. Set centered clearance within the 1 mm position allowance without squeezing hatch corners. Clamp lands and anchors remain outside the opening; tether recoverable pieces. Release straps and remove the hatch completely. Drill or cut only strips.
openings.prediction: Nearest rival: strap and pad friction already supply restraint. At unchanged strap marks, engaged stops predict bounded travel ending at an observed stop contact; withdrawn stops predict greater travel. Similar low travel makes this comparison uninformative, rather than disproving stop capacity. Travel beyond clearance, carrier migration, overlap loss under the right-side card, or damaging corner loading defeats the candidate. Unmeasured preload limits attribution.
openings.probe: Before fabrication, measure rim access, external clamp lands, bolt reach, strap routing, stop clearance and overlap with the card. Require stop withdrawal without changing clamp attachment or strap routing, and verify full open-aperture clearance. Park if unavailable. If feasible within ninety fabrication minutes, allocate twelve closure/pull trials across two configurations within twenty observation minutes: one disturbed closure with stops withdrawn, one disturbed closure engaged, then ten numbered opening cycles engaged, including the final disturbed closure. Apply supplied 20 N; record position against marks, stop contact, carrier migration, corner lift, reopening time and seal tears. After ten cycles require position within 1 mm, pull resistance, one-technician reopening within thirty seconds, recoverable parts, unobstructed opening, no permanent deformation and no new visible seal tears. Stop upon damage; no deployment follows this probe.
assumptions: Rim geometry, strip/bolt reach, strap length, stop overlap and component capacities suffice; these indispensable properties remain unknown.
Clearance can be set and measured meaningfully with the supplied ruler; strap marks only approximate equal preload.

assessment: One uncertain candidate; feasibility and discriminatory observations remain unestablished. Disturbance relaxes only seal-contact continuity.

lineage.reason: Carry separation of compression and registration into the refined carrier.
Preserve independent withdrawal; add contact evidence and distinguish inconclusive comparison from defeat.
